title: RELEASE: Idaho aims to anchor new nuclear innovation campus in Idaho | Gem State Chronicle
author: Brad Little
summary: Idaho has submitted a proposal to the U.S. Department of Energy to host a Nuclear Lifecycle Innovation Campus, aiming to enhance the state's role in advanced nuclear energy development. This initiative is significant as it could strengthen Idaho's economy, provide reliable energy, and reinforce its historical leadership in nuclear innovation. Governor Brad Little emphasized the potential for affordable, clean energy for Idaho families and the state's readiness to support the growth of the nuclear industry.
